items.content_html: Rhythm Navigator is a client side only webapp and CLI for exploring and sequencing binary/octal/hex rhythms represented as grouped digits. It combines an expressive rhythm generator (with contour analysis and music-theory predicates) with a lightweight multi-track drum sequencer that supports WAV/MIDI export and external MIDI output.
